findings.finding_text: Walker writes first-observation baselines into the production audit store; weekly unattended walk of in-flight runs fixes singular-hop baselines
findings.label: HIGH
findings.rationale: D10: walk a VACUUM INTO snapshot per pass via a read-only connection; walk CLOSED runs only; snapshot test proves source bytes unchanged.

findings.rationale: D2: DF3.8's observe line installed in crontab.factory at SWEEP_INTERVAL_MINUTES; pinned by test; live test drives observe --all, not a hand observe.

findings.rationale: DoD box unticked with note; no wake code exists factory-side (E21 config). Added production fence: no enqueueSystemEvent in A3 code. Fork + live round own the production proof.

findings.finding_text: Timed-out / unacked submits re-briefed next week under a new request id → possible second box; 'replays next sweep' claim false

findings.rationale: Cooldown now includes possibly-live codes; zero-dispatch weeks may be re-run with the SAME ids; exit 1 and 6 replay once; message corrected.
